file_roles.evidence: writeClassPathResources is deleted entirely, including 'Preconditions.checkArgument(classPathResources.size() == 1, "Expected exactly one jar on " + classLoader.toString())', which is the reported message verbatim. It is replaced by taking the runner's own jar directly: 'copyResourcesFromJar(new JarFile(mainClass.getProtectionDomain().getCodeSource().getLocation().getPath()))'. Assuming the classloader held exactly one jar was the wrong logic.

rationale: The exception text in the report, 'Expected exactly one jar on sun.misc.Launcher$AppClassLoader@1b6d3586', is produced by the Preconditions check the fix removes, so the throw site and the defect are the same method. The reported traceback is Python, 'portable_runner.py, line 545, in wait_until_finish', which only relays the remote job's failure state, so the log site and the fix are in different languages and different directories. The commit message states the corrected behaviour: 'Only copy the Spark runner jar, not whatever other jars happen to be on the classloader'.
notes: Cross-language instance: everything the reporter pasted is Python, while the entire fix is Java. Any localizer weighting the report's file paths is pulled toward sdks/python and away from runners/java-job-service.
